headlines.headline: LEBRON TELLS LAKERS HE'S LEAVING; L.A. FLIPS AYTON TO WIZARDS A DAY AFTER LANDING KESSLER
headlines.detail: LeBron James informed the Lakers he intends to play elsewhere in 2026-27, and the team responded by trading center Deandre Ayton to Washington for Jaden Hardy and two future second-round picks — a day after acquiring center Walker Kessler from Utah. Separately, the Clippers and Raptors are in trade talks for Kawhi Leonard, days after the Clippers were stripped of five first-round picks and owner Steve Ballmer was fined $30 million in the league's cap-circumvention probe.

headlines.headline: LEAGUE HEADS INTO KICKOFF WEEK WITH DEFENDING CHAMP SEAHAWKS HOSTING PATRIOTS
headlines.detail: The 2026 season opens Wednesday, Sept. 9, with Super Bowl LX champion Seattle hosting New England at Lumen Field in a rematch of the 29-13 title game. All 32 teams finalized 53-man rosters this week ahead of the opener.

headlines.headline: COLORADO STEALS OPENER FROM GEORGIA TECH 14-13 ON LATE TD, BLOCKED FIELD GOAL
headlines.detail: Deion Sanders' Buffaloes trailed 13-7 with under two minutes left before QB Julian Lewis capped an eight-play, 75-yard drive with a 20-yard touchdown pass to Charlie Williams. Georgia Tech's ensuing 45-yard field-goal attempt to retake the lead was blocked by Boo Carter, sealing a 14-13 Colorado win in college football's Week 1 opener.

headlines.headline: ELIGIBILITY CHAOS KEEPS RESHAPING ROSTERS 55 DAYS BEFORE TIP-OFF
headlines.detail: With the season opener still weeks away, several Big East programs — St. John's, Providence and Xavier among them — are still awaiting court rulings on eligibility cases that could materially change their rosters. Georgetown's Friday deadline for fall-semester enrollment underscored how late-breaking legal decisions are still shaping who's even on campus this close to the season.
